parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame is the main structural body of the cabinet, made of plywood. It provides the overall shape and support for the shelves and doors.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the entire cabinet structure, holding the shelves and doors in place, and ensures stability and durability.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that serves as the foundation for other components.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: The shelf is a flat horizontal board inside the cabinet, made of MDF, used for supporting stored items.
parts.Functional_description: It provides storage surfaces for organizing items within the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is typically fixed or adjustable vertically but does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet door is a front panel made of wood and glass, designed to open and close the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the cabinet’s interior and protects stored items from dust and damage.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates or slides depending on the hinge or track mechanism, enabling opening and closing motion.
